NAMED-INSTANCES RULE: When a slot contains a broad category concept (e.g., Biomarkers, Antihypertensive Agents, Diagnostic Techniques, Pathogens) AND the paper involves specific named instances of that category (e.g., specific protein names, specific drug names, specific gene variants, antibiotic brand/class names), add those specific instance names as tiab terms. BROAD FALLBACK FLOOR: Always keep the broad class MeSH and at least one broad tiab alongside the specific names - never replace broad coverage with only a named list. Example: ("Biomarkers"[Mesh] OR biomarker*[tiab] OR CRP[tiab] OR ESR[tiab]) is correct; (CRP[tiab] OR ESR[tiab]) alone is incorrect. INTERVENTION VARIANT COVERAGE: For intervention classes with many historical variants (antibiotics, biologics, antiseptics), include generation names, brand names, class names, and broad class terms. Wildcard (antibiotic*, biologic*) covers unknown variants.
